actual_tracking_issue.title: [AutoPerf F013] Targeted membership: no-gain after three comparisons
actual_tracking_issue.body:
**Measured no-gain: two actual targeted-send specializations, three complete comparisons. No performance-win PR or shipping change recommended.**

The actual >16-target SendConnectionsAsync branch still rescans caller-owned targets for each connection. Variant001 uses exact List.Contains and Array.IndexOf; variant002 removes the List fast path and uses array-only AsSpan().Contains. Existing <=16/direct-lookup and custom/derived collection dispatch are preserved. Neither experiment eliminates the original asymptotic cost.

[Immutable runnable project, complete raw experiments, proposed source/test snapshots and limitations](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/83f7bae3e8552110eec2ceb39a26864850056d92/F013/README.md)

## All measured outcomes

Negative change means lower candidate time. C1 is variant001 once; C2/C3 are variant002 twice, not three replications of one implementation. Role order original/candidate, candidate/original, original/candidate. No pooling or production weighting.

| Shape | C1 time change | C2 time change | C3 time change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| NoConnections512 | -21.96% | +7.71% | +15.57% |
| EmptyTargets | -0.67% | -0.63% | -10.61% |
| Small4List2 | -1.47% | -1.25% | +1.99% |
| Threshold16List | -1.35% | +1.42% | -0.65% |
| Threshold17List | -1.01% | -2.35% | -1.51% |
| C32List64Miss | +28.84% | -5.01% | -12.38% |
| C32Array64Miss | +12.56% | -2.34% | -0.99% |
| C32ReadOnly64Miss | -7.55% | -0.69% | -12.38% |
| C128List256Miss | +7.65% | +11.43% | -14.58% |
| C128Array256Miss | +9.61% | +7.01% | +9.36% |
| C32List64Sparse | +26.75% | -0.70% | -15.87% |
| C32Array64Sparse | +11.09% | -8.61% | -0.91% |
| C32List64All | -0.63% | -0.87% | -2.78% |
| C32DupList64 | +14.47% | -1.14% | -9.50% |

Variant001 regresses important large List/array cases, up to28.84% here. Array-only variant002 still regresses128-connections/256-array-miss time in both comparisons:38,849.417->41,572.482ns (+7.01%) and38,463.555->42,062.017ns (+9.36%). Small-array effects vary; untouched List/read-only/small-target and empty-store paths also move. No causal attribution of these control movements, isolated Contains gain, universal speedup or proof every possible optimization is impossible.

Six complete14-case profiles:84 reports,672 raw actual samples,645 retained,27 upper-filtered,252 warmups,1511 actual overheads. Every raw/retained/overhead/GC/settings result and mean/SD/CV/N remains in the immutable capsule. All3 authorized comparison slots are permanently spent, including any failed/partial timing; no extra F013 timing.

Allocation is actual BDN0.13/net12 process-wide GC bytes/op, not isolated membership/enumerator/serializer costs. All measured array-path allocations are unchanged. C3 unchanged List fallback reports66->65B/op; that single1B observation is retained, not an allocation win. Identical actual BDN DLL and prior source attribution verified, not freshly rebuilt source-to-DLL binding.

## Faithful boundary and coverage

Actual public DefaultHubLifetimeManager.SendConnectionsAsync over pre-created real HubConnectionContext/store connections, real lazy cached JSON serialization and fixed256-byte synchronous transport writers. Minimal call/frame/byte counters are timed; full exact recipient/frame validation is outside timing. Not network, handshake, connection creation, stateful reconnect, production frequency or general application throughput.

Fresh unchanged-original and each candidate actually pass28/28 owning rows (84 fresh total), including SendConnectionsAsyncPreservesDerivedListContainsDispatch and all four actual16/17 array/List rows of SendConnectionsAsyncWritesOnceToSpecifiedConnections.24 Facts per suite include12 inherited specification Facts. Zero skipped/failed rows or sentinel rows; not whole SignalR. Preservation is expected green on original/candidates, not functional bug-fix red/green.

Original and both candidate owners independently pass18 real producer checks+14 timed wrappers under both original/current JSON producers: six contexts. Real JSON argument getters remove initially requested IDs from same-count17-target arrays/Lists/read-only wrappers: one actual recipient, versus eight for explicit copied-input controls using the unchanged owner. Custom/derived ICollection.Contains dispatch, real17/256/2048 repeated misses, lazy serialization and actual Pipe completion/cancellation are established. Snapshot-input controls are not indexed owner implementations or timed optimizations.

Independent live and copied portable audits pass:108 producer/168 setup/168 delivery records,84 bounded PE/PDB witnesses/216 selected documents,623 source snapshots and168 unchanged settings point records. Paired80-file images share the exact compiled harness/PDB/BDN and other78 files; only owner DLL/PDB differ. Paired89-source trees differ only in owner, with identical fresh test source. Current JSON images differ only in JSON DLL/PDB.

Initial old F01127-row preparation evidence and original/current JSON bytes are explicitly borrowed/rehashed, not new F013 test runs/current producer builds. Fresh original test assembly and both candidate suites actually run. Every F013 producer observation/timing is independent; no prior group/broadcast timing reused. Captured default49147673007a4b1d676694e2c5f85b83ad76c36f selected source/JSON check, not whole-main SDK integration.

First added-helper test build fails CS1513/CS1519 before any owning test/assertion; exact bad source/full build log/binlog hash and premature raw plan-marker qualification retained. Two read-only audit schema/padding expectation failures retain exact failed readers/full stderr; corrected audit passes without changing experiments or rerunning a test/profile. A display-only original-runner interpolation typo is separately qualified. Preparation has17 native commands (16 successful/one failed build) plus4 passing whitespace checks.

Exact historical commands with observed exits: https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/83f7bae3e8552110eec2ceb39a26864850056d92/F013/validation-commands.md

Independent unchanged source branch: https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/tree/autoperf/F013-signalr-targeted-membership, baseline `37e809ead5824bc753a1c3d56f11615bdb1296c5`; actual remote ref/owner bytes verified. Both measured proposals and the new passing preservation test remain in capsule source snapshots.20 original source files restored byte-exact, no tracked source change; eight known output identities verified, six exact owner/test DLL-PDB replacements restored. No new build/test claimed for restoration.

Related dotnet/aspnetcore#69189 optimizes the already-existing <=16 path, not this remaining large-target scan; no upstream numbers reused. F011/F012 are separate group/broadcast findings; F014 remains independent.

Shared Windows VM, SDK12.0.100-alpha.1.26557.102/runtime12.0.0-alpha.1.26562.105, settings-preserving executor; no deliberate power/priority/affinity changes or isolation claim. Portable audit cannot rehash deliberately omitted binaries/binlogs or replay PE/PDB bindings. Full scope and limitations are in the immutable README.
